clue.text: Check text in block of paper (including covering note)

indicators.note: including means the pad holds the other pieces within it

parts.note: a pad is a block of writing paper
a roof is a covering over a building
re is the second note of the sol-fa scale

explanation.surface: Someone checks a document tucked inside a notepad, along with a note on top.
explanation.walkthrough: The bracket looks like an aside, but 'including' is the instruction; 'in' is only a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: To proofread is to check printed or written material for errors.

clue.text: Covered entrance for Spanish companion

parts.note: por is the Spanish word for 'for'
CH stands for Companion of Honour, a British order

explanation.surface: A sheltered doorway is offered to a Spanish friend.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for Spanish' means the Spanish word for 'for', POR. CH is a Companion of Honour, a British honour.
explanation.definitionFit: A porch is a roofed structure sheltering the doorway of a building.

clue.text: Johnson's laughter seen partly as an attack

indicators.note: only part of the phrase is seen, so the letters lie within the words Johnson's laughter

explanation.surface: A politician's laugh is interpreted as an aggressive move.
explanation.definitionFit: An onslaught is a fierce, sustained assault.

clue.text: Supporting ancient city, the man leaves to get preferred outcome

parts.note: to be for something is to support it
Thebes was an ancient city of Egypt and of Greece

indicators.note: the man departs, so his letters are taken out of the word the

parts.note: he is a pronoun for a man

explanation.surface: Someone backing an old city, with a man walking out, reaches a happier result.
explanation.walkthrough: 'leaves' takes HE out of THE, leaving T.
explanation.definitionFit: Something done for the best is meant to bring the most desirable result.

clue.text: Queen punches Brussels friend in the same way

indicators.note: a punch goes into its target, so the queen's letters go inside the others

parts.note: E for European, Brussels being the EU's seat
an ally is a friend

explanation.surface: The monarch lands a blow on a European partner, just as before.
explanation.definitionFit: Equally is an adverb meaning to the same degree or in an identical manner.

clue.text: Coming up through entrance, Marsh gets killed

indicators.note: through means the reversed marsh passes inside the doorway word

parts.note: a door is an entrance

indicators.note: in a down entry, coming up means the word Marsh is read from bottom to top

parts.note: a fen is a marsh

explanation.surface: Someone named Marsh is shot coming through a doorway.
explanation.walkthrough: Marsh looks like a surname but is a wetland; in a down entry 'Coming up' reads it bottom to top, giving NEF. 'gets' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Done for is an idiom meaning ruined, finished or dead.

clue.text: Spanish woman's half-hearted column

indicators.note: the doubled letter at the heart of the column word loses one of its pair

parts.note: a pillar is a column

explanation.surface: A Spanish woman's pillar is only half-heartedly built.
explanation.walkthrough: The heart of PILLAR is its LL; half of it goes, leaving one L. The 's is short for 'is'.
explanation.definitionFit: Pilar is a common Spanish female given name.

clue.text: Rung up cats?

indicators.note: in a down entry, up means the word for rung is read from bottom to top

parts.note: a step is a rung on a ladder

explanation.surface: Did someone phone the cats?
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rung up' looks like a phone call, but it is a ladder rung read upwards. The question mark marks cats as just one example.
explanation.definitionFit: Cats are an example of household animals kept for companionship.

clue.text: Put barriers in the way of naked philosopher

indicators.note: a naked word is stripped of its outer letters

parts.words: Put barriers in the way of
parts.note: to put barriers in the way of something is to block it

explanation.surface: Obstacles are set before a philosopher who wears no clothes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'naked' strips the first and last letters from BLOCKED.
explanation.definitionFit: John Locke was a 17th-century English empiricist thinker.

clue.text: Alters structure of rules about Dutch and French art

indicators.note: about means the word for rules goes round the other pieces

parts.note: a monarch reigns, that is, rules
es is French for 'art' as in 'thou art' (tu es)

explanation.surface: Someone restructures the regulations governing Dutch and French artworks.
explanation.walkthrough: 'French art' is the archaic verb, 'thou art': in French, 'tu es'.
explanation.definitionFit: To redesign something is to change its layout or form.

clue.text: One climbing scripture teacher reflects

indicators.note: a reflection shows things back to front, so the pieces are read backwards

parts.note: RE is religious education, the school subject of scripture
sir is how British pupils address a male teacher

explanation.surface: A religious studies teacher thinks back while climbing.
explanation.definitionFit: A riser is one who rises, that is, goes upwards.

clue.text: Continued going round without being seen

indicators.note: the letters spin round into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone kept circling and nobody spotted them.
explanation.definitionFit: Something unnoticed has escaped observation.

clue.text: Prime Minister Richard perhaps a romantic hero

parts.note: Edward Heath was British Prime Minister 1970-74
Cliff Richard is a British pop singer; the 'perhaps' marks Richard as one surname among many

explanation.surface: A former Prime Minister or a pop star is cast as a romantic lead.
explanation.walkthrough: Edward Heath was a British Prime Minister; Cliff Richard is a veteran British pop singer.
explanation.definitionFit: Heathcliff is the brooding lover in Emily Brontë's novel Wuthering Heights.

clue.text: Place to eat dog's breakfast

definitions.meaning: British slang for a muddle or shambles

explanation.surface: Somewhere to have a meal for a pet's morning food.
explanation.walkthrough: A 'dog's breakfast' is British slang for a complete muddle.
explanation.definitionFit: Soldiers eat in a dining room of this name, and a chaotic jumble is also this word.

clue.text: Used part of analogue time display

definitions.meaning: the pointer on a clock face that counts the seconds

explanation.definitionFit: Pre-owned goods are this, and so is the fastest-moving pointer on a clock face.

clue.text: Time wearing lead starts to offend your servant

indicators.note: the lead symbol has the time word on, as if dressed in it, so it sits inside

parts.note: Pb is the chemical symbol for lead
an age is a period of time

indicators.note: starts means only the opening letters of offend and your are used

explanation.surface: Someone with leadership offends, and a servant pays for it in time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wearing' puts AGE inside PB, the symbol for the metal lead, not leadership.
explanation.definitionFit: A pageboy is a young male attendant or uniformed messenger.

clue.text: Fighters initially getting in line to join terrorists in places

indicators.note: the second in means these pieces are placed within the word for places

parts.note: to put something is to place it

indicators.note: initially takes the opening letters of getting and in

parts.note: IS stands for Islamic State, a terrorist group

explanation.surface: Boxers queue up to join a militant group at various locations.
explanation.walkthrough: 'initially' covers both 'getting' and the first 'in', giving G and I; the second 'in' is the containment signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Pugilists are boxers, people who fight with their fists.

clue.text: Smelly birdman

parts.note: a ree is a female ruff, a wading bird
a king is a man, a piece in chess

explanation.surface: A man dressed as a bird gives off a bad odour.
explanation.walkthrough: 'birdman' splits into bird and man. REE, a female ruff, is a word seen mostly in crosswords; man is a chess piece.
explanation.definitionFit: Reeking means giving off a strong, unpleasant smell.

clue.text: Up-to-date information on satellite you and I find clever

parts.note: in means fashionable or up to date
gen is British slang for information
Io is a moon of Jupiter
us is you and me together

explanation.surface: Current news about a satellite strikes the two of us as smart.
explanation.walkthrough: 'gen' is British slang for information; 'find' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Ingenious means inventive and cleverly original.

clue.text: Understood a couple of points about sailor's visit

parts.note: to get something is to understand it
OS is an ordinary seaman
two compass points, east and east

explanation.surface: Someone grasped a few details about a seaman's trip.
explanation.walkthrough: The two points, E and E, come after OS in the answer; 'about' and the 's are link words in this charade.
explanation.definitionFit: To go to see someone is to pay them a visit.

clue.text: Active predator with no time for jewellery

indicators.note: active letters are lively and move into a new order
with no means the time letter is removed from predator

explanation.surface: A lively hunter with no time to spare goes after jewellery.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with no' removes T from PREDATOR; 'Active' rearranges the remaining PREDAOR.
explanation.definitionFit: An eardrop is a pendant earring, a piece of jewellery hanging from the ear.

clue.text: 17 mostly confused by first of several fall guys

indicators.note: confused letters are jumbled into a new order
mostly means the last letter of the 17 answer is dropped

parts.note: the answer to 17 across

indicators.note: first of takes the opening letter of several

explanation.surface: Several people go and see confused scapegoats.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mostly' drops the last E of GO TO SEE; 'confused' rearranges GOTOSE.
explanation.definitionFit: Stooges are dupes or patsies, people set up to take the blame.

clue.text: Cutter being comparatively serious

definitions.meaning: one who cuts through or separates

explanation.definitionFit: One who cuts things apart is this word, and it is also the comparative of an adjective for grave.

clue.text: When officer goes outside, go on

indicators.note: the officer surrounds the word for when, so it sits inside

parts.note: Lt is an abbreviation for lieutenant
as means when, as in 'as I left'

explanation.surface: When an officer steps out, things carry on.
explanation.definitionFit: To last is to continue or endure.

clue.text: Fight about energy weapon

indicators.note: about means the fight word goes round the energy letter

parts.note: to spar is to fight
E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: A battle breaks out over a power-charged weapon.
explanation.definitionFit: A spear is a long pointed throwing or thrusting weapon.

clue.text: In the south of France, unconscious of divine intervention

indicators.note: in means the unconscious word is set inside the French region

parts.note: Provence is a region in the south of France
the id is the unconscious part of the mind in Freud's theory

explanation.surface: Holidaying in southern France, someone is oblivious to heavenly help.
explanation.definitionFit: Providence is the protective care of God guiding events.

clue.text: Shelves have no large advantages

indicators.note: have no means the large letter is missing from shelves

parts.note: ledges are shelves

explanation.surface: Shelving without any big items offers some benefits.
explanation.definitionFit: An edge is an advantage, as in 'a competitive edge'.

clue.text: Nelson maybe finally gone — and died heroically

indicators.note: finally takes the last letter of each of gone, and, died, heroically

explanation.surface: Nelson, perhaps, is gone, having died a hero's death.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Nelson' suggests the admiral who died at Trafalgar, but it is Nelson Eddy, the American singer and film actor.
explanation.definitionFit: Nelson Eddy was an American baritone of 1930s musical films, so Nelson is an example.

clue.text: Without one making advances, series gets less substantial

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so the series letters go round

parts.note: a lender advances money

explanation.surface: Without anyone pushing forward, the series grows thinner.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Without' here means outside, not lacking; 'gets' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Slenderer is a comparative meaning thinner or slighter.

clue.text: By the side of American pine

parts.note: to pine is to long for something

explanation.surface: An American pine tree stands next to something.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pine' looks like the tree, but it is the verb meaning yearn.
explanation.definitionFit: Along can mean beside, as in 'trees along the river'.

clue.text: Agile one enters fine mist

indicators.note: enters means the one letter goes inside the agile word

parts.note: spry means agile
a means one

explanation.surface: A nimble person walks into a fine mist.
explanation.definitionFit: Spray is liquid dispersed in tiny droplets.

clue.text: They take off normal poets

parts.note: par is the normal or standard level
odists are poets who write odes

explanation.surface: Ordinary poets do impressions.
explanation.walkthrough: 'take off' means mimic, not leave the ground.
explanation.definitionFit: Parodists imitate or mock others' work, that is, take it off.
